settings.nav.title: Settings
settings.main.allowDownloadsHint: Show a "Download" button on the watch page so users can save the original media file to disk. Off by default — turn on for personal servers where you trust every account; leave off for shared servers where users should stream only.
settings.main.restartRequired: Restart required after changes — these are read at process startup.
settings.main.publicUrlHint: Used in OAuth/OIDC redirect URIs and LAN discovery responses. Leave blank to fall back to {fallback}.
settings.main.corsHint: Comma-separated origin list for cross-origin XHR. Use {star} to allow any origin (safe — the API authenticates via Bearer headers, not cookies). Leave blank for same-origin only. The TV and desktop apps are always allowed; they don't need to be listed.
settings.main.tmdbHint: Used to fetch movie/show metadata and cover art. Get a free key at {link}.
settings.main.tvdbHint: Optional. Used as a fallback for TV episode metadata when TMDB doesn't have the right numbering (anime, etc.). Get a free key at {link}.
settings.main.omdbHint: Optional. Adds IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic scores to movies and shows, fetched by an hourly task (Settings ▸ Library ▸ Tasks runs it on demand). Get a free key at {link}.
settings.main.omdbLimitHint: How many lookups the key allows a day: {free} for a free key, more for a paid one. Lower it if another app uses the same key. Lookups never go over this in any 24 hours, so a large library fills in over a few days.
settings.main.fanartHint: Optional. Adds clear logos, banners and disc art to movies, shows and music when they're enriched or refreshed. Art already next to your media (clearlogo.png, banner.jpg, disc.png) is used first. Get a free personal key at {link}.
settings.main.arrKeyPlaceholder: Enter an API key for Radarr/Sonarr webhooks
settings.main.arrKeyHint: Set a shared API key to allow Radarr, Sonarr, and Lidarr to notify OnScreen when new media is imported. OnScreen will automatically scan the affected directory.
settings.main.arrHowTo: In {service}: {menu}. Set the URL above, trigger on {onImport} and {onRename}, and add a custom header {header} with your API key.
settings.main.pathMappingsHint: If your arr apps run in Docker, their file paths won't match local paths. Map the remote prefix (e.g. {remote}) to the local prefix (e.g. {local}).
settings.main.osEnableHint: Lets viewers search OpenSubtitles.com from the player subtitle picker. Requires an API key below.
settings.main.osPassHint: Logging in bumps the daily download quota from 5 to 20+. Credentials are stored server-side only.
settings.main.osLangsHint: Comma-separated ISO-639-1 codes used as the default search filter. Leave blank to let viewers pick per-search.
settings.main.subAutoEnable: Download missing subtitles for new movies and episodes
settings.main.subAutoHint: The "Download missing subtitles" task (Settings › Tasks) searches OpenSubtitles for each language below that a file has no subtitle in yet — embedded, a file next to it, or an earlier download — and saves the best match. Needs OpenSubtitles set up above; the daily download quota is shared with viewers' own downloads. Libraries can turn it on or off for themselves.
settings.main.subAutoHash: Prefer subtitles made for the exact file (hash match)
settings.main.scrobblingHint: Users link their own Last.fm and Trakt accounts under {link}, and those links run under the credentials here. Replacing an app later breaks existing links: each user connects again.
settings.main.lfmHint: Create an API account at {link}. No callback URL is needed.
settings.main.traktHint: Create an app at {link} with the redirect URI {uri} (users link with a code, not a redirect).
settings.main.langPrefsHint: Set default audio and subtitle languages. The player will auto-select matching tracks when available.
settings.scrobble.moved: Scrobbling has moved to your Account page.
settings.optimized.notice: Optimized versions are smaller MP4 copies (H.264 + AAC) made ahead of time. When a player would otherwise need a live transcode — a codec it can't decode, or a bitrate limit away from home — the server hands it a version that fits instead, and it plays directly. Queue them with {optimize} on a title's page or a library. They are encoded one or two at a time ({env}) alongside converted downloads, and deleted automatically when the original file is deleted or replaced.
settings.audit.emptySub: Security-relevant actions will appear here as they occur.
settings.sso.oidcHint: Generic OIDC SSO (Authentik, Keycloak, Auth0, Azure AD, etc.). Set the redirect URI in your IdP to {uri}.
settings.sso.ldapHint: Bind-as-user authentication. The server first binds with the service account, searches for the user record using {placeholder}, then re-binds as that user with the supplied password.
settings.sso.skipTlsWarning: {warning} TLS certificate verification is disabled. Any attacker on the network path can impersonate your LDAP server and harvest user passwords as they bind. Use this only for local development with self-signed certificates — never in production.
settings.sso.samlHint: SP-initiated SSO via the IdP's metadata URL (Okta, Azure AD, ADFS, OneLogin, Authentik, Keycloak). Register the SP at {url} on your IdP (or upload that XML if your IdP doesn't fetch by URL). The SP keypair is auto-generated on first save when left blank.
settings.sso.spCert: SP certificate (PEM — advanced; auto-generated when blank)
settings.sso.spKey: SP private key (PEM — advanced; auto-generated when blank)
settings.tasks.configInvalid: Config must be a valid JSON object
settings.tasks.name: Name
settings.tasks.cronHint: Standard 5-field cron expression (min hour dom mon dow).
settings.tasks.retainHint: Older dump files in the output directory are removed.
settings.tasks.ocrHint: Walks every file and OCRs image-based subtitle streams (PGS/VOBSUB). Multi-hour on large libraries.
settings.tasks.emptySub: Create periodic jobs like database backups or library rescans. They run on the cron schedule you choose.
settings.transcode.copyFailed: Copy failed — select and copy manually
settings.transcode.tuningSaved: Saved — the internet limit applies now; encoder, output-limit and ABR changes after a restart
settings.transcode.restartNote: changes take effect after a server restart
settings.transcode.encoderTuningHint: Fine-tune FFmpeg encoding parameters for your GPU and network. They apply to this server's built-in transcoder and to converted downloads, and are read at startup, so {restart}. Remote transcode workers use their own {nvencEnv} and {ratioEnv} settings.
settings.transcode.presetHint: Speed vs quality trade-off. Lower presets reduce GPU load.
settings.transcode.tuneHint: HQ is best for media servers. LL/ULL are for live streaming.
settings.transcode.rcHint: VBR gives the best quality per bit. CBR provides stable bandwidth.
settings.transcode.ratioHint: Peak bitrate = target bitrate x ratio. Higher values handle complex scenes (action, grain) better but use more bandwidth.
settings.transcode.outputLimitsHint: Global ceilings on transcode output — clients can request lower, never higher. Applied at startup, so {restart}.
settings.transcode.maxBitrateHint: Upper bound on the transcode target bitrate. Default {value}.
settings.transcode.noRestartNote: Takes effect on the next stream, no restart.
settings.transcode.internetHint: A lower ceiling for viewers outside your home network. A remote video stream above it is transcoded down instead of played as the original file. Per-user internet caps (Users ▸ Streaming caps) apply on top — the lowest wins. Music is never limited. {noRestart}
settings.transcode.internetLimitHint: Match your upload speed, leaving headroom for more than one viewer.
settings.transcode.localNetworksHint: Already treated as home: private addresses (192.168.x, 10.x, 172.16–31.x, fd00::/8), loopback, link-local, this server's own IPv6 network, and 100.64.0.0/10 — so devices on your Tailscale network count as home. Add a VPN or office range here. Behind a reverse proxy or Cloudflare, the viewer's real address is only known if the proxy forwards it.
settings.transcode.abrHint: Multi-rendition HLS — the player switches rungs on real-time bandwidth. Applied at startup, so {restart}.
settings.transcode.abrMaxHint: 0 = source. An explicit quality pick can never exceed this.
settings.transcode.abrAutoHint: Soft cap for AUTO playback. Default {value}.
settings.transcode.fleetHint: Manage the transcode workers that process HLS jobs. The embedded worker runs inside the server process. Local workers are separate processes on this machine. Workers auto-register when started.
settings.transcode.deviceHint: Picking a device enables every codec it can hardware-encode (H.264 for 1080p, HEVC for 4K bitrate savings, AV1 on Ada/Blackwell). The worker picks the right codec per session.
settings.transcode.maxSessionsHint: Cap on concurrent transcodes. Applies live on save — no restart. Leave 0 to use the server default ({env}).
settings.transcode.loadTitle: Cost-weighted load (a 4K stream counts ~4× a 1080p one)
settings.transcode.tonemapTitle: GPU HDR→SDR tonemap (libplacebo/Vulkan) — HDR jobs route here first
settings.transcode.name: Name
settings.transcode.noWorkers: No local workers running. Workers auto-register when started — add one here to pre-configure its name and encoder.
settings.transcode.remoteTitle: Add a worker on another machine
settings.transcode.remoteHint: Offload transcoding to another computer: install OnScreen there, choose {workerOnly} in the installer, and enter the values below. The worker pulls jobs from this server and streams segments back — it shows up under {localWorkers} above once it connects.
settings.transcode.workerAddrHint: The worker machine's own address, e.g. {example}.
settings.transcode.revealedWarn: ⚠ Full credentials shown — they include the database password and your server's master key.
settings.transcode.revealPrompt: Re-enter your password to reveal the real {db} and {secret}.
settings.transcode.envHint: The host above is this server's detected LAN address. Until you reveal them, the {password} in {db} and the {secret} live in this server's {env} (e.g. {path}); if the host shows a placeholder, fill in this server's LAN IP manually.
settings.transcode.lanWarn: ⚠ This server binds Postgres and Redis to localhost by default. For a worker to connect, expose them on your LAN: set {listen} + add a {pgHba} rule for the worker's subnet in Postgres, bind Redis to the LAN interface, then restart the OnScreenPostgres / OnScreenRedis services.
settings.users.quotaUserError: {label}: enter a whole number from 0 to {max}, or leave blank for the default
settings.users.quotaDefaultError: {label}: enter a whole number from 0 (unlimited) to {max}
settings.users.windowError: Window: enter a number of days from {min} to {max}
settings.users.windowHintDay: Requests per day. Blank = server default, 0 = no limit. Past the limit, requests wait for approval.
settings.users.windowHintWeek: Requests per week. Blank = server default, 0 = no limit. Past the limit, requests wait for approval.
settings.users.windowHintDays_one: Requests per {count} day. Blank = server default, 0 = no limit. Past the limit, requests wait for approval.
settings.users.windowHintDays_other: Requests per {count} days. Blank = server default, 0 = no limit. Past the limit, requests wait for approval.
settings.users.moviesNeedApproval: Movie requests from "{name}" now need approval
settings.users.tvNeedApproval: TV requests from "{name}" now need approval
settings.users.savedRatingLimited: Saved for "{name}" — takes effect only if the rating limit is removed
settings.users.moviesAutoApproved: Movie requests from "{name}" are now approved automatically
settings.users.tvAutoApproved: TV requests from "{name}" are now approved automatically
settings.users.dailyLimitInvalid: Daily limit must be 0 or more minutes
settings.users.inviteHint: Share this link with the user. It expires in {days} days.
settings.users.cannotChangeSelf: Cannot change your own admin status
settings.users.defaultsHint: Applies to accounts created from now on. Household profiles start with auto-approve off.
settings.users.quotaHint: Applies now to every user without their own limit, existing accounts included. 0 = no limit. Past the limit a request still goes through, but waits for approval. Admins are exempt.
settings.users.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {name}? This cannot be undone.
settings.users.watchBody: Set a daily time cap and allowed hours for {name}.
settings.users.overnightHint: Set the end earlier than the start for an overnight window (e.g. 22:00 to 06:00).
settings.users.labelsBody: Limit what {name} sees by the labels on titles (set on a title's page, or with "Add label…" in a library selection). A label on a show covers its episodes. Also applies to their managed profiles; saving signs them out so it takes effect at once.
settings.users.allowedHint: Leave empty to allow everything not blocked. When set, unlabelled titles are hidden too.
settings.users.capsBody: Limit streams for {name}. Enforced server-side; leave a box unchecked for no cap.
settings.users.bitrateHint: A direct play above this is re-encoded down; transcodes are capped to it.
settings.users.remoteHint: Applies only when they stream from outside your home network, together with the server-wide internet limit (Settings ▸ Transcode) — the lowest wins. Music is never limited.
settings.users.devicesBody: Devices signed in as {name}. Signing one out leaves the others alone.
settings.users.signOutElsewhereConfirm: Sign out every other device signed in to your account? This browser stays signed in.
settings.users.signOutEverywhereConfirm: Sign {name} out on every device? Streams in progress stop.
